description: Audit and fix package.json files and pnpm lockfile to ensure CI install commands succeed. Verify all declared dependencies resolve correctly and the lockfile is consistent with package.json declarations.
steps: Step 1: Verify the root package.json 'packageManager' field matches what workflows use. Currently 'pnpm@10.26.1' which matches workflow 'corepack prepare pnpm@10.26.1 --activate'. Confirm node engines '>=22.0.0' is compatible with actions/setup-node node-version: '22'.

Step 2: Verify the pnpm-lock.yaml lockfileVersion (9.0) is compatible with pnpm 10.26.1. Run 'pnpm install --frozen-lockfile' to confirm it works. If it fails, regenerate with 'pnpm install --no-frozen-lockfile'.

Step 3: Check all package.json files for version consistency issues. The root and edge have typescript@^6.0.3 while frontend has typescript@~5.8.3. Verify these all resolve correctly from the registry (we confirmed typescript 6.0.3 exists on npm).
Step 4: Run 'pnpm --filter syrabit-edge exec tsc --noEmit' and 'pnpm --filter @workspace/syrabit exec tsc --noEmit' to verify type checking passes.
Step 5: Check if there are any peer dependency warnings or resolution conflicts that could cause issues in CI. Run 'pnpm install' and check for warnings about unmet peer dependencies.
Step 6: Verify the pnpm overrides in root package.json are properly applied: 'esbuild@<0.25.0' -> '>=0.25.10' and 'ws@<8.18.3' -> '>=8.18.3'. These are security patches.

Step 7: Check the apps/backend/requirements.txt is valid. It uses pip-compile with hashes. The workflow strips hashes for install (grep -v '--hash'). Verify this works by running the same command the CI uses.
acceptance_criteria: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile succeeds from repo root
TypeScript type checking passes for both edge and frontend workspaces
Backend requirements.txt hash-stripping install command works
The lockfile is consistent with all package.json files
verification: Run: pnpm --filter syrabit-edge exec tsc --noEmit (must exit 0)
Run: sed 's/ *\\$//' apps/backend/requirements.txt | grep -v '^\s*--hash' > /tmp/requirements-nohash.txt && pip install -r /tmp/requirements-nohash.txt --dry-run (or just validate parsing)
findings: All verification steps passed with no changes needed. (1) packageManager pnpm@10.26.1 matches all workflow corepack prepare commands. engines node >=22.0.0 compatible with node-version: 22 in workflows. (2) pnpm install --frozen-lockfile succeeds - lockfileVersion 9.0 is compatible with pnpm 10.26.1. (3) TypeScript versions: root+edge use ^6.0.3 (resolves to 6.0.3), frontend uses ~5.8.3 (resolves to 5.8.3) - both present in lockfile. (4) tsc --noEmit passes for both syrabit-edge and @workspace/syrabit. (5) No peer dependency warnings or conflicts - only expected 'ignored build scripts' notice. (6) Overrides working: esbuild resolves to 0.27.3/0.27.7/0.28.0 (all >=0.25.10), ws resolves to 8.20.1 (>=8.18.3). (7) Backend requirements.txt hash-stripping works correctly with sed+grep pipeline.
